//: These settings are easier to change in-game! Mod List -> Stack Refill -> Config

Enable Stack Refill.//: Whether Stack Refill is enabled. When disabled, none of its features run and its other settings are hidden. Takes effect after a restart.

refillBlocksAndItems.//: Whether the hand is refilled when the last item of a stack is placed, used, eaten or thrown. For example blocks, food, bone meal, eggs and potions.

refillToolsAndWeapons.//: Whether an item with durability is replaced by the same item from the inventory when it breaks or is thrown. For example tools, swords, fishing rods and tridents.

refillAfterDroppingLastItem.//: Whether the main hand is refilled when its last item is dropped with the drop key.

refillBuckets.//: Whether buckets are refilled. When disabled, a bucket that is emptied or filled stays in the hand instead of being swapped for another bucket from the inventory.

refillFromOtherHotbarSlots.//: Whether the other hotbar slots are searched as well. When disabled, only the main inventory is used to refill the hand.

itemBlacklist.//: A comma separated list of item ids that are never refilled. Use * as a wildcard. An id without a namespace matches items of every mod. For example 'minecraft:totem_of_undying,*shulker_box'.

itemWhitelist.//: When not empty, only the items in this comma separated list are refilled. Same format as itemBlacklist, for example 'minecraft:*_planks,cobblestone'.
